content.heading:
About
me
paragraphs: I’m a pragmatic digital product designer with over a decade of experience designing for the web and apps. I enjoy working closely with developers to come up with clear solutions to complex problems.

I thrive where design and development meet: shaping ideas, prototyping quickly, and refining products through real collaboration. I care about thoughtful UX, practical solutions, and building products that genuinely work for users.


I want to be part of a team where design and development work side by side to create meaningful digital products.
